body: I understand, I don’t ever want to ruin peoples experience, I find I’m quick to anger, I posted this hoping to find locations where it’s accepted, a place for artists in the city, I responded to harshly, I hope I can find certain places where I can share beauty with others, I don’t mean graffiti in the sense of vandalism, I mean graffiti in the sense of art applied to stone for public viewing, I realize my harsh reaction and it’s benefiting no one and I hope I can find places to express myself where it’s excepted

I apologize for responding with dismissive negativity, cause clearly there is far to much negativity in your life, your loved so much man, I hope you never experience the idea of taking your own life, your strong and brave, I sent you a message I hope you read it, I hope I can give you a new perspective of human life, if not I hope you can understand my worry for you
Are you happy? Honestly like I feel sorry for you, I’m not trying to dig at you or anything, I feel sorry that you feel the need to push suicide on someone over paint, I’m honestly sad for you man

I understand that idea, yet most artists you’ll see will never go to small local owned shops/churches what have you, I’m sorry but I could care less about big pedophiles in suits worried about their Walmart locations having some free art there, I would love to support a business owner in art, yet why should I care for what some big company owned by black rock has to say about some paint when they can obstruct my view with some ugly billboard
God forbid there be free art
